heading: INT. ST. BRIDGET'S CHURCH BASEMENT - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ST. BRIDGET'S CHURCH BASEMENT - NIGHT
MONTAGE - FOLDING CHAIRS, STYROFOAM CUPS, A BANNER THAT SAYS "ONE DAY AT A TIME" WITH THE "ONE" PEELING OFF
I am telling you, the sober cake is not a cake, it is a loaf, and I will not be lied to about baked goods in a house of God.
units.name: KIM HALLORAN
paren: slamming a coffee pot onto the table, steam rising

units.name: KIP HALLORAN
paren: sitting in the circle, raising one finger like a student

units.text: Technically we are all in the basement.
units.name: MR. DELACROIX
paren: rubbing his eyes under his glasses

units.text: This is the loudest this room has been all year.
You promised me, Kip. You said no more texts to the ex.
units.name: KIM HALLORAN
paren: pointing at Kip with a stir stick

units.text: ON PHONE: "KIP: just checking in. hope u are well"
That's not me. That's a different Kip.
units.name: KIP HALLORAN
paren: hiding the phone under his thigh

units.text: There is only one Kip, and the Lord has seen your thumbs.
units.name: SISTER AGNES
paren: from the folding table, arranging donuts into a perfect spiral

units.text: Can I say something? I only came for the donuts, and I am now somehow crying, and that is Kip's fault.
units.name: BIG TOMASZ
paren: raising his hand slowly, standing, sitting back down, standing again

units.name: KIM HALLORAN
paren: softening, setting down the stir stick

units.text: Okay! Deep breaths. In through the nose. Out through the donut.
units.name: MR. DELACROIX

units.text: Take one. They are not a sacrament.
units.name: SISTER AGNES
paren: offering the plate around the circle

units.name: KIP HALLORAN
paren: taking two, handing one to Kim

units.text: Truce. But the loaf thing stands.
units.name: KIM HALLORAN
paren: biting into it, rolling her eyes
